runs.prompt:
TASK CONTEXT — FANTASY-GAME ASSET RESTORATION: a faithful high-definition reconstruction of the statue painted in the EXISTING Might and Magic VII decoration sprite, as a 3D modelling and texturing reference. Not a new design. Input 1 is the original native sprite and sole DESIGN AUTHORITY for shape, pose, proportions and parts; cyan and black border are background. Input 2 is for stone surface material only, never design.
The object is a carved STONE SCULPTURE (one solid piece of weathered stone: speckled warm grey granite), matte, slightly weathered, fine chisel and grain detail, no paint. Whole statue visible and centred, filling about 80% of frame height, near-orthographic camera, true transparent background, no floor, no cast shadow, no text. Even soft neutral studio light (no dramatic light; Meshy bakes light into albedo).
Identity: a stone statue of a knight in full plate armour standing upright: a ROUNDED great helm (a barrel or bucket helm with a domed top, a slight brow ridge and one narrow horizontal eye slit cut into the front), smooth rounded pauldrons, a plain breastplate, a short fauld over the hips, plate arms with gauntlets, plate legs and sabatons. His RIGHT hand rests on the pommel of a straight cross-hilted longsword standing upright beside his right foot, its point on the plinth. His LEFT arm hangs at his side. He stands on a sloped stone plinth: a low truncated pyramid (wider at the bottom) about one fifth of the total statue height.
Do NOT add spikes, crest, plume, shield, cape or an open visor; do not make the helm flat-topped or cubic; do not crop any part; do not add a floor, backdrop, second figure or text. One statue only. Deliver a 1024 x 1536 PORTRAIT image with actual alpha transparency.
VIEW: front-left three-quarter (the statue's own front turned about 35 degrees toward the image's RIGHT), camera a little above chest height. This is the primary reference.
runs.reason: Rejected pointed helmet, T-shaped slit, hooked guard and wrong viewing direction; alpha later confirmed genuine.
